agent.problem: Most of the stop's choices are discoveries or lucky guesses rather than informed picks. Cards 2, 3, 5, 6, 13, 14 and 17 ask for a plan, name, feeling, number, field detail, land use or prophet that the earlier cards do not give enough context to reason out. The blanks on cards 3, 6 and 13 are especially dependent on unseen wording or details. Only a few discovery questions are allowed; most choice cards need setups or replacement questions that let the baker reason from what has already been told.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer. The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question. A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
